text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One busy day of training leading up to the Arima Kinen…

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: UNACCEPTABLE!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Uhh, what is?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: The Arima Kinen of course! How can they treat me as if I'm some commoner?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I also declared I'm running! So why are you the talk of the town!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Nya-ha-ha… To be honest though, I'm not enjoying any of this.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After leaving a good impression on the audience at the Kikuka Sho, Seiun Sky has become the racer to watch out for in the upcoming Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: "What does she have up her sleeve for the Arima Kinen? Expectations are soaring for Seiun Sky's tricks!"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: The news, social media—you're all anyone's talking about!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I haven't found even the slightest mention of myself! How humiliating!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: There, there.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Guess this means I changed everyone's opinion of me too much. Not that that doesn't have its benefits…

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: If everyone thinks me a capable runner now, how do I turn that idea on its head? It's time to show 'em what I really got. ♪

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Why'd you go quiet all of a sudden? It's scary. All out of comebacks or something?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: …How are you able to take this so lightly?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Don't you feel the enormous pressure to perform well?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: …King?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: …Never mind. Forget what I just said.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I'm not entirely sure… but I think it's because I can be practical about it.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Practical?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I'm not trying to live up to anyone's expectations. I'm going to win just because I want to.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I made it this far by doing what I have to, and the crowd just happened to find it entertaining.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I'm not a racer with incredible skills or anything. All I can do is run my own way.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: To make it sound cooler… at your final wrong turn, you'll have found the right path.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: The right path…

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: So, yeah… It's not that I'm taking this lightly.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: …I think I understand.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Sigh…

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Hm? King?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Sky!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Yes?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: At the Arima Kinen! I, and no one else…

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Will catapult you out of the spotlight! SO BE PREPARED!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Man, she made me jump. Why is she always so loud?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Probably. I bet she's just been overthinking it.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: She'll pull herself together. She's strong like that.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I kinda understand how she feels though, having to push herself back on her feet alone.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Later on, we coincidentally run into another of Sky's peers…

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Oh, Sei.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Heya, Grass. On your way to training?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Yes! There are a few final things I must prepare for.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Grass Wonder glances down at her legs. She spent the first half of her classic year mostly recovering from an injury.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Guess you've got nothing to worry about anymore. I'll be facing you in all your splendor in the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Hehe, of course, I'll be there at my best. I take it you're in good condition as well?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: In a way, I suppose. Can't seem to go anywhere without seeing the next person's think piece about me.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Is that so? That doesn't sound so bad to me.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: No way! Some people are saying I can't compare now that you're at full strength.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Even if that's the case, I'll still have to use every ounce of my soul to make sure I don't lose.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Because I must win this year's Arima Kinen. There is no other option.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I have to get going now. Take care.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: …I might be in trouble.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Grass… I think she's managed to surpass perfection.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Looks like meeting everyone's expectations won't come easy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Our first preparations for the Arima Kinen conclude with a disquieting glimpse of what's to come…
